text:
Marta Nguyen: heads-up — the optimize toolkit docs still show a 32 token microbatch example for shortseq workloads. That example causes OOM on 4GB T4 with q4_0 in our tests. Also the Go SDK snippet link at the bottom is 404: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/examples/go/optkit_shortseq.md

Ava (docs): thanks for flagging. can you paste the minimal repro + what model/quant profile you used? i'll open a PR to update the example once we have a repro. :thumbsup:

Marta Nguyen: repro below — seq_len=16, requests batched by 32, model rwi/llama-13b q4_0, memory spikes and OOM after ~120s.
```
# simplified load/test loop
batch_size = 32
seq_len = 16
model = "rwi/llama-13b:q4_0"
# call to SDK: Generate(stream=False, batch=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len)
```

Ravi Shah: FYI, kernel selection changed last week — q4_0 uses a different block size that can increase peak mem for microbatches. Consider lowering batch_size to 8 or recommend q8_0 with prefix KV caching.

Ben K: we should also add a note in the optimize guide about fallback quant profiles for low-memory GPUs and an example config for the runtime: `runtime.fallback_quant: [q4_0, q8_0]`.

DocsBot: lint check failed on new PR #1234 — examples/optkit/shortseq.md: link to `examples/go/optkit_shortseq.md` returns 404. CI log: https://ci.redwood.dev/logs/1234

Ava (docs): ok — plan: 1) Jing will fix the Go snippet and push updated file 2) Marta will run batch-size sweep and provide numbers for the doc table 3) I will open a PR to add a fallback recommendation + small config snippet. target: EOD Friday. tagging reviewers: @Ravi, @Ben.

Jing Park: I can take the Go snippet. will replace link with `examples/go/optkit_shortseq_v2.md` and add a tiny note showing `batch_size=8` as safe. will push a branch later today.

Marta Nguyen: did a quick sweep — batch_size 32 fails, 16 is unstable, 8 is stable across 10 runs. attaching numbers in PR when ready.

Ava (docs): awesome. once Jing pushes I'll open the PR and set reviewers. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

Ben K: also please add a short troubleshooting section: "OOM on low mem GPUs" with quick mitigations (reduce batch, use q8_0, enable prefix caching).

Ravi Shah: can we add a runtime guard that rejects configurations we know will OOM for dedicated pools? filing infra task separately. :thinking_face:

Ava (docs): good call — I'll add a TODO in the PR and cc infra. thanks everyone — ping here if anything blocks the EOD goal. :rocket:
